title: Goldbach and Alexandroff Shake Hands
summary: We introduce a relational Alexandroff topology associated with the strong Goldbach conjecture on the set of even integers greater than or equal to six. The construction is induced by a multivalued map encoding Goldbach representations and leads naturally to a notion of relational reachability. For arbitrary binary relations, we show that singleton closures coincide with reachable sets and that the common intersection of all singleton closures consists exactly of the globally reachable points.
